summary: Duke Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 35,000,000 Equity Units at $50.00 per unit, raising $1.75 billion gross. Each Corporate Unit consists of a purchase contract for Duke common stock and interests in Remarketable Senior Notes due 2032 and 2036 bearing 4.85% interest. Underwriters have a 13-day over-allotment option for 5,000,000 additional units. The offering is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Settlement is expected on August 13, 2026, under T+2. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; this is a standard equity-linked issuance by an operating utility.
